# Marketing Team Meetings (Will start when company meeting ends)
Date: 2026-10-13 | Duration: 60.7400016784668m

## Summary
The team examined user engagement, noting 1% click-through on product pages versus 0.25% on editorial and AI pages, while detailed articles averaged 64 seconds. GA4 limitations prompted new HubSpot and Plausible dashboards and discussion of a canonical analytics source. The November 3 5.2 release will simplify experiment creation, clarify “experiment values,” add five metric types, and introduce interleaving support, Session Replay beta, and a warehouse compute dashboard. Sales messaging, demos, Slack documentation, product analytics training, website updates, design-system access, lead routing, and HubSpot email integration are progressing. Content work includes a new 15-minute Growth Book tour video, blog updates, case studies, and G2 integration. Pricing analysis found that accounts with 11+ seats generate 63% of revenue, supporting further validation of experiment-based pricing without immediate changes.

## Keywords
Product Launch, Analytics Strategy, Demo Improvements, Pricing Analysis, Documentation, Website Updates
